summary_1line: Hanuman kills the demon general Akampana with an uprooted tree, causing the terrified rakshasa army to flee back to Lanka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman, pierced by arrows yet blazing with fury, uproots a massive tree and smashes it down upon the demon general Akampana.
The demon army drops their weapons and flees in panic toward Lanka while monkeys chase them across the battlefield.
Hanuman stands victorious amid cheering monkeys as the gods, Rama, and Lakshmana honor him after the battle.
